aboutHtml:
We're Brett and Shelly Elliott, and we've built this business around genuine expertise and local service. We stock a full range of STIHL equipment for domestic and commercial use, plus Hustler and Cub Cadet ride-on mowers.

Our STIHL Platinum Certified Technician Simon brings 25 years of mechanical know-how. He handles servicing, repairs and technical advice on the equipment we sell.

Whether you need to buy a new tool, service equipment you own, or get advice on what suits your needs, we're here. Come in and talk to us. We're open Monday to Friday 8am to 5pm, and Saturday 9am to 12pm.
